label: Terminate member infra
description: Delete one member's copy of an infra node and its disk. The member's triggers reading it go down with it, the way `triggers` says; the member's runs using it follow `running`.

inputs.name: node
inputs.description: The infra node marked `@per_member`, named the way the program writes it (`bridge`, or `one.bridge` inside an included file).

inputs.name: member
inputs.description: The member, by the id your program uses for them (`user-42`).

inputs.name: triggers
inputs.label: Triggers
inputs.description: What happens to the member's triggers reading it: park keeps what arrives for later, hibernate keeps it for a grace window, wipe drops it.

inputs.name: running
inputs.label: Running work
inputs.description: What happens to the member's runs still going: wait lets them finish, cancel stops them now. Wipe needs cancel.

inputs.name: graceMinutes
inputs.label: Grace minutes
inputs.description: How long hibernate keeps accepting what arrives. Ignored by park and wipe.

inputs.name: includeSelf
inputs.label: Stop this run too
inputs.description: Off: this run keeps going even when it is one of the runs reached. On: this run ends with them, cancelled.

outputs.name: done
outputs.description: True once the member's triggers reading the copy are down and the terminate is handed to the supervisor, which deletes the copy on its own time. Wire it into the `_should_flow` of what must happen after.
